note: Flagged for Review. Items here do not block publication. Each item says what was checked, what was not, and the source link for manual review.

items.title: Submitted link codes are not the ASINs the pages resolve to
items.detail: Each submitted link.amazon URL carries a 9-character code after the slash (e.g. B04G1MEwY). Each one resolved to a different Amazon listing (ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z). The codes in the submitted links were therefore NOT used as the intended ASIN. The observed ASIN is stored in its own field.
items.checked: fetch_page on all five submitted links (final URL and page title read).
items.not_checked: Whether the link.amazon short-link service maps these codes to the listed ASIN by design.

items.title: Intended ASIN cannot be confirmed for any of the five rows
items.detail: Because the intended ASIN is not confirmed by the submitter, the field is blank for all five products. The observed redirect ASIN is shown separately and is not treated as confirmation.
items.checked: Field kept blank per the verification rule.
items.not_checked: The submitter's intended product for each link.

items.title: The 10-character ASIN format rule comes only from third-party sites
items.detail: The brief says Amazon's ASIN definition gives a checkable identifier. The format 'ten characters, usually starting B0' was found only on third-party blogs, not on an Amazon page retrieved in this session. It is used here only to flag the 9-character submitted codes, not as a verified Amazon definition.
items.checked: Searched for the ASIN definition; read three third-party pages that agree on 10 characters.
items.not_checked: An official Amazon help page defining the ASIN (not retrieved).

items.title: Selected tracking ID not observed in any redirect target
items.detail: The selected tracking ID shopnow047c-20 does not appear as a tag= parameter in any of the five observed redirect URLs. Attribution of the supplied links to this tracking ID therefore cannot be confirmed from these fetches.
items.checked: Read the final URL of each fetch for a tag= parameter.
items.not_checked: Amazon Associates tracking report (requires a logged-in Associates session; manual).

sources.label: Operating Agreement §1 (Special Links must use the tagged formats Amazon provides)

items.title: Supplied short links have not been validated as Special Links
items.detail: The Operating Agreement says links must use the special 'tagged' formats Amazon provides (defined as Special Links). The supplied link.amazon URLs have not been tested in the enrolled Associates workflow. This session makes NO claim that they are invalid; their compliance status is unresolved (see FLG-003 link in the brief). The Special Link test needs a logged-in Associates account and is a manual step.
items.checked: Operating Agreement text read (section 1).
items.not_checked: Associates dashboard Special Link generation and tracking-report test.

items.title: Price and rating of each main product were not confirmed
items.detail: The fetched text for each listing did not include the main product's price or star rating in a form that can be attributed to that ASIN. Those fields are blank. Prices and ratings shown in carousels on the same pages belong to other products and were not used.
items.checked: Fetched listing text read for price and rating.
items.not_checked: Live price (price must be shown only from an official, time-stamped source per the Associates rules; not confirmed here).

items.title: Listing pages contain widget and carousel data for other ASINs
items.detail: The fetched Amazon pages include 'Product summary' header links and 'Customers who viewed' carousels with prices and ratings for other ASINs (for example, the same pricing link pointing to a different product). These were not added as rows and were not used as data for the five products.
items.checked: Read the page content for the five listing pages.
items.not_checked: Each carousel item (out of scope; only the five submitted links are in the table).

items.title: Dimensions, weight and capacity beyond the title are not verified
items.detail: Only capacity or count values that appear in the listing title are recorded (e.g. 6 Quart, 26QT, 8 Qt, 3 Ultra-Thin Probes). Item dimensions were not confirmed in the fetched text, so no counter-space or capacity-per-centimetre figures are calculated (see Analysis).
items.checked: Title and breadcrumb text read.
items.not_checked: Product details tables (dimensions, weight, material).

items.title: Related products were not added
items.detail: The table covers the five submitted links only. Related products from carousels were not added or verified.
items.checked: Scope check against the brief.
items.not_checked: Related products.

items.title: FTC guidance read; applicability to this site needs a reviewer decision
items.detail: The FTC 'Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers' brochure (November 2019 text) was read. It says a disclosure should be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement itself, use simple words such as 'sponsored', and not appear only on a profile page or at the end of a post. It is written for social-media influencers. Whether and how it applies to affiliate links on a website is a reviewer decision. The full Endorsement Guides PDF was not read.
items.checked: FTC Disclosures 101 page and brochure text read.
items.not_checked: Endorsement Guides (PDF); 'The FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking'.

sources.label: FTC: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers (read)
